notes.title: Patch 1.0.1713
notes.content:
Greetings AO fans!

A new update for AO Tennis 2 is now available to download on Steam. Please read the Patch Notes below to learn about its content.

[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*] Ultrawide Monitors are now supported.
[/list]
[i][b]Developers comment[/b]: We’ll give ongoing support for Ultrawide beyond the version that is now available.
[/i]
[h2]Players[/h2][list]
[*] Addition of new playable characters: Petra Kvitova, Alexei Popyrin & Taylor Fritz.
[/list]
[h2]AI[/h2][list]
[*] Tuned AI unforced error rate.
[*] Tuned Clay and Grass Court bounce speed physics.
[*] Tuned side spin physics.
[*] Tuned AI serve direction.
[*] Tuned difficulty levels.
[*] Tuned career decline of on-disk players.
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2][list]
[*] The Loading times have been improved.
[*] Game performance have been improved.
[*] The Injury system has been improved.
[*] The Reflex animations has been improved.
[*] The Shot reach range has been improved.
[*] Resolved cases where unforced errors were not allocated to statistics.
[*] General stability improvements.
[/list]

Thank you for the ongoing support and feedback!

Sincerely,

notes.title: Day One Update
notes.content:
Hello AO fans,

With the release of AO Tennis 2 we have a Patch Day One already available to download on PC. You can check the content added through the Patch Notes below:

[h2]Gameplay[/h2][list][*] Addition of 3 new mid-game statistics:[list][*] Clutch Weight
[*] Time Pressure
[*] Win Prediction[/list]
[*] Addition of a new player Nick Kyrgios.
[*] Modification of some Shot animations.
[*] Updated player ratings and styles.
[*] Improvements to animations.
[*] Improvements to sound balancing and general match atmosphere
[*] Improvements to gameplay.
[*] Adjustment of the difficulty levels – to make the lower levels a little easier.
[/list]

[h2]User Interface[/h2][list][*] Addition of frames to the menus.
[*] Improvements to UI.
[*] Additional support for non-Latin characters in UGC.
[/list]

Let us know if you've experienced any issues, our team will do their best to resolve them as soon as possible.

Thank you for playing!
